summary.zh-TW: 按下愛心：空心縮掉、實心彈出，外框方塊擴散、十顆小方塊往四周噴開，按讚數往上滾一格。在圖片上點兩下也能按讚，中間會跳出大愛心。取消按讚則安靜地縮回去。
summary.en: Tap the heart: the outline shrinks away, the filled heart pops in, a square ring expands and ten tiny squares burst outward while the count rolls up. Double-click the photo to like with a big centre heart. Unliking quietly shrinks back.

text.zh-TW: 先放大超過一點再回到原尺寸，像被按下去又彈回來。括號裡的數字越大，「超過」的幅度越大。
text.en: Overshoots slightly before settling, like a press that springs back. The bigger the number, the bigger the overshoot.

text.zh-TW: 粒子沿著圓周平均分佈，再加一點隨機的角度和距離（gsap.utils.random），看起來自然而不是死板的放射狀。
text.en: Particles are spread evenly around a circle, then nudged with random angle and distance (gsap.utils.random) so the burst looks natural rather than rigid.

text.zh-TW: 每次按讚都會新增粒子，飛完一定要移除，不然連按很多次頁面上會堆滿看不見的元素。
text.en: New particles are created on every like, so remove them when they finish — otherwise repeated taps pile up invisible elements.

text.zh-TW: 慶祝只給「按讚」。取消時安靜地縮回空心，動態的情緒要和動作的意義一致。
text.en: Celebrate only the like. Unliking quietly shrinks back — the motion’s mood should match the meaning of the action.

text.zh-TW: 按讚按鈕是「切換」的按鈕，用 aria-pressed 讓讀屏軟體唸出「已按下／未按下」。點兩下圖片只是捷徑，鍵盤使用者用按鈕就好。
text.en: A like button is a toggle; aria-pressed lets screen readers announce pressed or not. Double-clicking the photo is a shortcut — keyboard users use the button.
